{{Quote|Rogue ship, this is the ''Coruscant Port Authority''. You have entered restricted airspace. Please identify yourself.|Coruscant Port Authority, to [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] aboard [[Kenna's starship]]|<ref name="The Collector" />}}
The '''Coruscant Port Authority''' was an organization based on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] which was active during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. It monitored the [[Realspace/Legends|airspace]] around Coruscant and was in charge of identifying incoming [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. Shortly after his [[Mission to an abandoned planetoid|mission]] to an [[abandoned planetoid]], [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Mace Windu/Legends|Mace Windu]] requested permission to land to the Coruscant Port Authority while traveling back to Coruscant aboard [[Kenna's starship]].<ref name="The Collector" />
